blurb: Guests can enjoy wine tasting flights, guided winery tours, and a Tipsy Tutorial to learn about wine pairing. The winery hosts concerts, special events, and offers a farm-to-table dining experience with a build-your-own charcuterie menu on the patio. Accommodations are available in a restored 1865 farmhouse with suites and modern amenities.
